sources: recreation.gov public campsite search for facility 234614 (per-site catalog)

values.note: $15 a night per single site; additional vehicle $5 a night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/alta-campground ('Single Site: $15 per night', 'Additional Vehicle: $5 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234614/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 15), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/alta-campground ('Utility hookups are not available') + recreation.gov catalog for 234614 (all 14 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 14 sites including 1 host site; gravel spurs. The Forest Service says sites 'will accept RV's or trailers to 30''; the recreation.gov catalog lists max vehicle lengths of 40-70 ft, which the Forest Service's own statement was preferred over.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/alta-campground ('Alta Campground features 14 campsites with 1 host site', 'Site will accept RV's or trailers to 30'') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234614 ('Parking spurs are gravel') + recreation.gov catalog for 234614 (Max Vehicle Length 40-70), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Drinking water at several spigots in the summer months; accessible vault toilets, trash, campground host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/alta-campground ('Water is available during the summer months at several locations within the campground', 'Vault Toilet(s)') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234614 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided. A campground host is available on-site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 'Some sites are reservable, and others are available on a first-come first-served basis' (the recreation.gov catalog: 9 reservable, 5 not). Reservable sites on a 6-month rolling window; recreation.gov closes reservations 3 days before arrival. Up to 16 nights (regional order).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/bitterroot/recreation/alta-campground (Reservations: 'Some sites are reservable, and others are available on a first-come first-served basis. For reservable sites, individual sites at this campground operate on a 6-month rolling basis'; 'You may stay up to 16 nights during a visit') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234614 (rules: reservationCutOff 3 'day(s) prior to arrival') + recreation.gov catalog (9 reservable, 5 not), read 2026-10-22

note: Bitterroot NF (West Fork RD) along the West Fork of the Bitterroot River, about 29 mi up West Fork Road (MT-473) from US-93 south of Darby, past Painted Rocks Lake; paved road all the way, no cell coverage. Ponderosa pine shade. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page and recreation.gov confirm $15 (2026; +$5 extra vehicle), no hookups, 14 sites incl. host, RVs/trailers to 30 ft, water (summer) and vault toilets, some sites reservable on recreation.gov and some first-come. Added the 6-month window (was inherited), 3-day reservation cutoff, 16-night limit. Not stated: a campground season (the rate table's peak season is not one). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Missing phone: West Fork Ranger District 406-821-3269 (Forest Service page and recreation.gov). Run by the Forest Service (campground host on site); no concessionaire named.
recreation.gov's catalog lists max vehicle lengths of 40-70 ft against the Forest Service page's 'RV's or trailers to 30''; kept 30.
